# ResizableEdge

`Flare.Components.ResizableEdge`

Which edge of a FlareResizable carries the drag handle.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Right` | `0` | Drag the trailing edge to change the width (the default). |
| `Bottom` | `1` | Drag the bottom edge to change the height. |
| `Left` | `2` | Drag the leading edge to change the width. |
| `Top` | `3` | Drag the top edge to change the height. |

## Used by components

- `FlareResizable`
